user.title: Add ReefTank
user.description: ReefTank stores your aquariums for the aquarium view of ha-reef-card. Aquariums are created and edited from the card.

change.name: Change between the last two tests

state.other: Not explained by CO2: test KH, check the probe
state.kh: KH drop, measured by the tests
state.probe: Faulty reading: neither KH nor CO2 moved

catalog_incompatible.message: Catalog {version} needs ReefTank {minimum} or newer: update the integration first.

catalog_unknown.message: The latest catalog release is not known yet (no connection to GitHub?).

feed.name: Feed
feed.description: Records a feeding of an aquarium (fires its feeding event and animates the fish in the card).

aquarium.name: Aquarium
aquarium.description: Name, id or device id of the aquarium.

source.name: Source
source.description: Id of the feeding source (optional): the fish gather at its feeding point.

livestock_add.name: Add livestock
livestock_add.description: Adds animals to the inventory of an aquarium (merged with the line of the same species).

aquarium.name: Aquarium
aquarium.description: Name, id or device id of the aquarium.

note.name: Note
note.description: Free text kept with the inventory line.

size_cm.name: Size range (cm)
size_cm.description: Minimum and maximum size, in cm: [min, max].

species.name: Species
species.description: Catalog id of the species, or any name.

water.name: Water
water.description: Water of the aquarium (main tank by default).

livestock_remove.name: Remove livestock
livestock_remove.description: Removes animals from an inventory line (losses, rehoming); the line goes when empty.

aquarium.name: Aquarium
aquarium.description: Name, id or device id of the aquarium.

line_id.name: Line id
line_id.description: Id of the inventory line (or give the species).

species.name: Species
species.description: Species of the line, when no line id is given.

monitoring_configure.name: Configure monitoring
monitoring_configure.description: Chooses what is monitored in an aquarium and sets the alarm thresholds. Only the fields given are changed.

aquarium.name: Aquarium
aquarium.description: Name, id or device id of the aquarium.

orp_entity.name: ORP entity
orp_entity.description: Numeric entity giving the ORP in mV.

co2_entity.name: CO2 entity
co2_entity.description: Numeric entity giving the CO2 of the room in ppm (optional): tells a CO2 effect from an alkalinity problem.

kh_entity.name: KH tests entity
kh_entity.description: Sensor or number giving the last KH test in dKH (optional), such as the last measurement of a ReefDose head. Tells a KH drop from a CO2 effect or a probe problem.

ph_calibration_entity.name: pH calibration entity
ph_calibration_entity.description: Entity changing when the pH probe is calibrated, such as its last adjustment date.

orp_calibration_entity.name: ORP calibration entity
orp_calibration_entity.description: Entity changing when the ORP probe is calibrated, such as its last adjustment date.

pause_entities.name: Pause entities
pause_entities.description: The analysis is suspended while one of them is on.

learning_days.name: Learning days
learning_days.description: Days of history the tank is compared with.

ph_base_drop.name: pH drop
ph_base_drop.description: Alarm when the 24 h mean falls this far below the usual level.

ph_swing_pct.name: pH swing (%)
ph_swing_pct.description: Alarm when the 24 h swing exceeds the usual one by this much.

ph_profile_band.name: pH day band
ph_profile_band.description: Smallest gap from the usual day that counts.

ph_profile_hours.name: pH day hours
ph_profile_hours.description: Consecutive hours off the usual day before the alarm.

orp_drop_mv.name: ORP drop (mV)
orp_drop_mv.description: Alarm when ORP stays this far below its usual level.

orp_drop_hours.name: ORP drop hours
orp_drop_hours.description: Hours ORP must stay low before the alarm.

kh_change_max.name: KH change (dKH)
kh_change_max.description: Alarm when two consecutive KH tests differ by more than this.

pause_hours.name: Pause hours
pause_hours.description: How long the pause switch stays on before resuming by itself.

monitoring_reset.name: Reset monitoring
monitoring_reset.description: Forgets the recorded history so that the aquarium learns again (a new probe, say).

aquarium.name: Aquarium
aquarium.description: Name, id or device id of the aquarium.

channel.name: Measure
channel.description: Measure to forget (all of them when empty).

init.title: Catalog updates
init.description: The fish and coral species are downloaded from the ReefTank catalog and kept up to date.
